intro: From brand identity to social content and digital campaigns, AVERLI connects how a brand looks, what it says, and how it reaches the right audience.

projects.name: Villa Unuk
projects.description: An editorial sales brochure for a residential development in Primošten. Architectural imagery, carefully paced layouts, and clear information bring the property’s character onto the page.

projects.name: Legame
projects.summary: An identity for keeping what matters.
projects.description: A typographic identity for an artisanal photobook brand. Inspired by the Italian word for ‘bond’, the logotype brings a quiet, considered detail to the act of preserving memories.

projects.name: Lastavica Cruising
projects.summary: A considered presence, on and off the water.
projects.description: Creative direction and social media design for an Adriatic yacht charter. A cohesive visual language and content plan connect the atmosphere of the experience with its digital presence.

about.heading:
A design eye.
A marketing mindset.
about.text: AVERLI is an independent brand, design, and marketing studio. Built on a background in graphic and digital design, with hands-on experience in content, campaign creative, and marketing coordination.
about.second: The approach is connected from the start: understand the business, find a clear visual direction, then carry it through the places people actually encounter the brand. One thoughtful point of contact, from the first conversation to the final detail.
